_help: url: where the game runs (start it first, e.g. a local static server). steps run in order: wait (ms) | key + hold (ms) | click [x,y] | move [x,y] | eval (JS in the page, e.g. start a match or set a camera) | shot ('hero' or a name) | record {name, seconds, steps} (frames are grabbed while the nested steps run).
